scope: Test-only four synthetic public Stroke controls; existing native-stream sampler and mesh; Rust centroid-alpha tessellation with approximate analytic fwidth, shared Scene SVG and native PDF exporter. Not public dispatch, arbitrary saved-stroke admission, exact shader behavior, or device parity.
metrics: [native support, export support, intersection, union, RGB L1 on union]; support differs from 252 by more than 2 in any channel. resvg SVG and PyMuPDF PDF raster at 256x256; PDF default 96dpi page rasterized at 4/3.
reproduction: With an empty directory set SDOCX_MONTBLANC_CAPTURE_DIR to its path and run cargo test -p sdocx --lib --features pdf captured_controls_shared_scene_exports; then run .venv/bin/python tools/montblanc/public-candidate/scene_compare.py DIRECTORY. The Rust test refuses existing output files. Without the environment variable it performs in-memory checks only.
